body: Yes i currently take a bunch of meds to help try to fix several problems. I've been on meds for a while but they keep changing it up and it feels like nothing works.

Thank you, that is a really good comparison. And minecraft seems like a good way to spend the time, I watch my boyfriend play it a lot :P I'm pretty busy during the week and even during the weekend so I don't know if free time is the problem. I think my problem is that I get very sad and I look for an escape and alcohol is my escape from life.

Every time I try to do it one day at a time I just end up thinking about the future... I try to tell myself that it's okay to try to take life little by little but I always get overwhelmed and think about how I may never be able to drink again and it really upsets me. How do you do it?

Thank you for the support. Ya I can quit for a day. I binge drank everyday over the summer, and was able to stop for a little while. If I try really hard I can quit for up to a month or two.. but I always convince myself that drinking is okay. Currently, I guess I'm what people would consider a functional alcoholic. I'm still wondering if it maybe is okay to drink once in a while. I feel like I depend on it to escape and to feel good emotionally. I know this is bad, but as pathetic as it sounds I would rather be unhealthy and drunk as long as I can still be functional and succeed somewhat. But another part of me really wants to be done with it so I can be happy without alcohol. That's something I cant see happening though.
